title: A change that alters no meaning is a task with no story
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure.
decision: A change that preserves behaviour and adds or alters no meaning (a refactor, chore, docs or style change, in the industry's words) is a task with no story: one builder, one pull request, one review, the check passing.
consequences: The task and proportionality concepts state this.
